Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Where this piece sits in inventory and shop lists. Lower comes first.

Fields.Name: Wandering Equip ID
Fields.Description: The piece other players see on your wandering ghost instead of this one. This probably hides models their game cannot load.

Fields.Name: Vagrant: Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: The reward roll for the Vagrant this piece may become. -1 spawns none, and 0 grants nothing.

Fields.Name: Good Vagrant: Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: The reward roll for the extra creature a Good Vagrant may bring. -1 drops nothing, and 0 grants nothing.

Fields.Name: Evil Vagrant: Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: The reward roll for the creature an Evil Vagrant may bring. -1 drops nothing, and 0 grants nothing.

Fields.Name: Repair Price (souls)

Fields.Name: Reinforcement Price (souls)
Fields.Description: What each upgrade costs. Shop sale prices are set elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Sell Value (souls)
Fields.Description: The price Kingseeker Frampt probably pays for this piece.

Fields.Name: Weight (kg)

Fields.Name: Knockback
Fields.Description: Lowers how far hits push you. Higher is steadier.

Fields.Name: Knockback Repulsion %
Fields.Description: May set how strongly hits bounce off you. This is unproven.

Fields.Name: Durability
Fields.Description: The durability a found piece starts with.

Fields.Name: Max Durability
Fields.Description: The highest durability a repair can restore.

Fields.Name: Poise
Fields.Description: Lets you take heavier hits without flinching. Heavier armor usually gives more.

Fields.Name: Repulsion Defense
Fields.Description: Helps bounce enemy attacks off this piece. The exact check is unproven.

Fields.Name: Defense: Physical
Fields.Description: Flat physical defense this piece adds. The game stores and reads it as a whole number of 0 or more, so it cannot be negative. For negative protection, give the piece negative absorption (Armor Rework) or an effect that raises damage taken.

Fields.Name: Defense: Magic
Fields.Description: Flat magic defense this piece adds. The game stores and reads it as a whole number of 0 or more, so it cannot be negative. For negative protection, give the piece negative absorption (Armor Rework) or an effect that raises damage taken.

Fields.Name: Defense: Fire
Fields.Description: Flat fire defense this piece adds. The game stores and reads it as a whole number of 0 or more, so it cannot be negative. For negative protection, give the piece negative absorption (Armor Rework) or an effect that raises damage taken.

Fields.Name: Defense: Lightning
Fields.Description: Flat lightning defense this piece adds. The game stores and reads it as a whole number of 0 or more, so it cannot be negative. For negative protection, give the piece negative absorption (Armor Rework) or an effect that raises damage taken.

Fields.Name: Defense Correction: Slash
Fields.Description: Changes this piece's physical defense against slash attacks by this percentage: -100 makes it 0, 50 makes it one and a half times. It is not a defense value of its own.

Fields.Name: Defense Correction: Strike
Fields.Description: Changes this piece's physical defense against strike attacks by this percentage: -100 makes it 0, 50 makes it one and a half times. It is not a defense value of its own.

Fields.Name: Defense Correction: Thrust
Fields.Description: Changes this piece's physical defense against thrust attacks by this percentage: -100 makes it 0, 50 makes it one and a half times. It is not a defense value of its own.

Fields.Name: Status Resist: Poison
Fields.Description: How much poison buildup this piece soaks. Higher delays poisoning.

Fields.Name: Status Resist: Toxic
Fields.Description: How much toxic buildup this piece soaks. Higher delays toxic.

Fields.Name: Status Resist: Bleed
Fields.Description: How much bleed buildup this piece soaks. Higher delays bleeding.

Fields.Name: Status Resist: Curse
Fields.Description: How much curse buildup this piece soaks. Higher delays curse.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement Type ID
Fields.Description: The upgrade table this piece uses. It sets how much defense each level adds.

Fields.Name: Achievement ID
Fields.Description: The achievement tied to this piece, if any. -1 means None.

Fields.Name: Shop Level
Fields.Description: Unknown. How shops use levels is not established.
